findingsAndCorrections.finding: P1: public PENDING-idempotency retry could recreate a missing admission with the replacement process owner, then reconcile the original execution
findingsAndCorrections.originalEvidence: Independent static trace through IdempotencyRepository.execute/claim/abandon and TaskEngine.callOperation/#executeOperation; not reproduced in a live database by this agent
findingsAndCorrections.correction: Both recovering=true and explicit persisted-admission recovery skip createAdmissionIntent. Missing storage throws ADMISSION_INTENT_MISSING before any Adapter reconcile/start. A genuinely new admission still captures its current owner.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: P2: after reloading intent, retry-local timing/anchors/context could still replace original scheduled admission or reset its deadline
findingsAndCorrections.originalEvidence: Independent static trace and failing scheduled public-engine retry unit test using repository/Adapter doubles
findingsAndCorrections.correction: Branch selection, Adapter reconciliation/start, identity validation and publication use the complete durable intent: owner, arguments, authorization/correlation, reservation, timing, accepted/notBefore/latestStart/deadline and TTL. No auth policy, idempotency lease or TTL algorithm redesign.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: P2: unconditional empty attributes.correlation changed unrelated resource-event attributes and record bodies
findingsAndCorrections.originalEvidence: Static comparison with existing exact-attribute Provider telemetry transport tests
findingsAndCorrections.correction: Ingress and committed Task event producers add canonical correlation only when correlation/trace/explicit claims supply actual entries. Existing explicit claims remain non-authoritative; no top-level alias or recordHash algorithm change.

observationTime: Admission timing anchors remain original. Adapter response/observation handling still uses the current engine clock. Newly committed task.scheduled observations use PostgreSQL clock_timestamp(), not the old admission acceptedAt. Existing retention calculation remains unchanged.

red.sourceState: Unmodified c452def product code plus the new unit regression file
red.failures: Missing durable intent and omitted scheduled timing both reached the Adapter dispatch double; the genuinely new admission case passed

actualValidation.boundary: Unit doubles exercise the real public engine retry callback; they do not prove PostgreSQL durability, real Adapter RPC or a live-device reproduction.

pendingPostgres.environment: TEST_DATABASE_URL must identify the Run Controller's leased disposable PostgreSQL database
cases: Frozen no-auth HTTP admission and committed identity across successful idempotent replay/get/notification projection
Public interrupted-admission retry through actual IdempotencyRepository, unchanged owner/accepted/deadline/TTL/reservation/correlation, current observation time and one Adapter side effect
Delete only the test-owned admission after Adapter acceptance/publication failure; public retry keeps the PENDING key and rejects before reconcile/start without inventing a replacement owner
Scheduled publication failure followed by default-timing public retry stays SCHEDULED, retains original timing/context, emits current-time observation, and dispatches zero Adapter starts
Stable command IDs and canonical non-authoritative Task-linked ProviderOps, plus exact unlinked resource attributes without an invented empty correlation object
pendingPostgres.resources: Unchanged: one random wi080_identity_<uuid> schema in the supplied DB and the existing TypeScript mock Adapter on a loopback ephemeral gRPC port. No external UGV connection or simulator containers.
pendingPostgres.cleanup: Closes test gateway/Adapter/pools and drops only the exact test-owned random schema. Container/database lifecycle belongs to Run Controller.
pendingPostgres.optionalExistingTransportSelector: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/integration/provider-telemetry-ingress-postgres.test.ts -t 'preserves Struct payloads across the real VehicleTelemetry gRPC transport|serializes plain records for every public telemetry gRPC client'

preservedEvidence.note: Original candidate, report and 22-test result are preserved unchanged as historical evidence, not proof that the rejected candidate satisfies the uncovered public-retry cases.

limitations: No shared PostgreSQL, Docker, external network/device or live navigation was used by this implementation agent.
Clean development bootstrap remains required; no old populated database owner backfill or compatibility work.
No independent ProviderOps export wire, live Task-bearing SSE, physical arrival or Gate PASS is claimed.
No push or integration adoption; root owns the control-repository Handoff and independent review.
